clues: The polka-dot umbrella was not Gus's.
Mabel's umbrella was the plaid one.
Kit's umbrella was neither the yellow one nor the polka-dot one.
hints: Look at Kit's row. After clues 2 and 3, how many umbrellas could still be Kit's?
Clue 3 gives Kit two X's, and Mabel's dot from clue 2 crosses out plaid for everyone else. Look for the only choice left.
So Kit left the navy umbrella. Gus then has only yellow left, since clue 1 rules out polka-dot.

solution.key_idea: Clue 3 and Mabel's plaid umbrella cross out three of Kit's four squares, so Kit's umbrella was navy.
steps: Clue 2 gives Mabel the plaid umbrella, so no one else left the plaid one.
Clue 3 rules out yellow and polka-dot for Kit, so Kit left the navy umbrella.
Clue 1 rules out polka-dot for Gus. Plaid and navy are taken, so Gus left the yellow one.
solution.epilogue: All four umbrellas went home before the noon ferry: plaid to Mabel, yellow to Gus, navy to Kit and polka-dot to Oscar. Priya's lost-and-found stayed at forty-one.

tip: Each time a dot goes in, cross out the rest of its row and column before reading on.
